:::{#sol-epe-no-bias-no-variance}

$0 + 0 + 3 = 3$.
The [population variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) $\varpar = 3$ of the [noise](#def-noise) remains,
so $3$ is the smallest [expected squared prediction error](#def-epe) any [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) can have here.

:::
